summary: Recall takes periodic snapshots of your screen so you can search back through your activity. It is on by default on Copilot+ PCs but can be turned off and deleted entirely from privacy settings.

steps.path: Settings → Privacy & security → Save snapshots → toggle off
Same page → Delete snapshots → Delete all (removes existing captures)
Optional: Settings → Privacy & security → Recall → toggle off 'Save snapshots' via Group Policy (Pro/Enterprise)

collateral: you lose the ability to search back through past screen activity
snapshots can take significant disk space if left running
regionNotes: Recall is opt-in for new users in the EEA and UK. It is on by default in the US.
whyTheyDidIt: Microsoft wants timeline-based search to be a Copilot+ differentiator.

sources.label: Microsoft Support — Manage Recall snapshots and settings
MakeUseOf — I disabled all 10 AI features in Windows 11
